name: Progress-7
about: Progress-7 (1979-059A), a crewed vehicle (Progress), launched 1979 Jun 28. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1979 Jul  6), held fixed
docked to S10382; GCAT's later phases (auxiliary catalogues) are not read yet
